notes.title: Big game update!
notes.notes:

We are launching it in a test format, if you like it and we will notice the feedback, we will continue to work in this direction, improving the game!

The new game mod supports 5/5 people game.

Added:
- New game mod (Football)
- New location (Arena)

P.S. Dear friends, we will be very glad to receive your feedback in the form of feedback about the game.
We will be very glad to hear your suggestions.

notes.title: Discord update + last giveaway of 5 keys
notes.notes:
[h1]The giveaway.[/h1]
Do you want to participate in the last giveaway by winning a key of 'I Will Eat You'?
Then go ahead and head over to the #giveaway channel on our Discord.
Hit the 🎉 emoji and you are automaticly participated.

This is the last wave of 5 keys, in the future we will provide more giveaways but for now we keep it calm! If you are a content creator or related then please contact us.

If you are not in our Discord then here is the link: https://discord.gg/EZyZDkW
Share this with your friends and maybe they will win a key as well to play with the community and eat you!

[h1]The Discord update![/h1]
Discord recently got some chances and more will follow in the future.
We now have a 'Looking2Play' role which can be mentioned in the 'Looking2Play' channel.
People can wear this role and use @Looking2Play mention to find people to play, teamup and hangout with. People who wear this role will also get shown on the member list on the right side of Discord. Abusing this role/command is not tolereated and actions will be taken as we want to have the Discord a clean, fun and nice place for everyone.

And the second thing we added is something just for fun.
By going to the #reaction-role channel you can now choose to be a wolf, bear, tiger or a wild boar and once clicked on this role, you'll be shown as one.

More in the future!!

Have an amazing day!
Team GSE Games and Wholf

notes.notes:

P.S. We will continue to support the game and release add-ons for it.

notes.title: Major update.
notes.notes:
In this update, we added:

- Set up a game store
- Added 3 new achievements
- Now we have a Discord server (you can enter through the main menu)
- Fixed bugs in all locations
- Optimized each location and balanced the load on the PC
- Spent work on the balance of the game
- Expanded game settings. Now you can adjust the game volume and mouse sensitivity
- Added 2 game characters
    - Ping (Can create teleport)
    - Yuka (Can clone himself)
    - Linda (May poison the beast)
    - Jack (May become a raven)
- Added 2 new guitar sounds
- Improved the musical design of gaming locations and menus
- Worked on character abilities
- Worked on the game interface
- Added boot screen
- Optimized game widgets
- Optimized game code
- Fixed server errors
- Added effect on turning a player into a rabbit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017546/049a0780cdf5ada5a62cd2b91a3ded10ca7a48b9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36017546/9a62e1db7727db6b12cc2acc15f691af0ac5e585.png[/img]

Corrections and balance.

- Removed totems from the game (to win, you need to hold out)
- Increased distance of getting XP with a guitar.
- Visually displayed the roar of the beast.
- The roar of the beast began to work better to find players.
- Removed the FUN indicator.
- Ravens now work correctly and do not make the character laugh.
- improved Japanese

P.S. We continue to work on the bugs.
